annotations.title: Edge Lab — every tool graded by model version, live and test

description: Use for "which version of your model is working", "what are you testing" and "how has Bitcoin Edge done since its last change". Every public PredictionMarketsPicks tool graded by model version and track (live or a labelled test version): picks, W-L, net after fees, ROI on the side's cost, the breakeven win rate and a 90% lower bound, on pick-date windows. Optional tool, window (30d/90d/all), by_bucket. A record, not picks.

by_bucket.description: true splits each version by the cost of the side taken (<40c … 85c+).

tool.description: Optional tool: bitcoin, gold, silver, oil, weather, nhl — or a tool slug. Omit for every public tool.

window.description: 30d, 90d or all (default all) — picks MADE in the window.

name: edge_lab

rows.description: Per tool, model version and track (live or test): picks, settled, W-L, net after fees, ROI, win rate, breakeven, 90% Wilson lower bound.

tell_user.description: Show this sentence to the user first.

tracks_present.description: Which tracks have rows (live; test once a test version is minting).

title: Edge Lab — every tool graded by model version, live and test
